test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if 'NEWTON' is written as 'LUCFKL', 'PASCAL' is written as 'JYGWYN', how will 'TESLA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a1f1c2e0e287e69cf4678c429807103b753e0dd63cdb4c9fb12ff6a7e198b59.png] 

Now,

 
• 'NEWTON' is written as 'LUCFKL'.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de0bf40bfcc057d19c4a59811d03ec3fec21587af70306b1f509ad614ff8c6ea.png] 
 
• 'PASCAL' is written as 'JYGWYN'.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0253baad12fd9a6262d6ebd910cb4ddcccff0ab369be7a396d31280fa03690d.png] 
 
• Similarly, for TESLA:
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee2a85e3d0da36b64a605380a396463a18a9511f95d4140e823cba4d923df3b5.png] 

So, ***TESLA*** is written as ***FUGNY.***

Hence,** FUGNY** is the correct answer.
